base_currency.note: When more than one currency is in scope, always define exactly one base currency for roll-up reporting; deal/line-item currency fields should default to it.

overwrite_risk.description: A workflow action is flagged as an overwrite risk when it sets/updates a property unconditionally (no "only if blank" / conditional qualifier) — this can silently clobber manually-entered or integration-sourced data.
